## Checks

CI on a pull request from a fork may wait for a maintainer to approve it, so please run these locally first:

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` shows no errors (warnings are fine)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] User-facing changes have a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot (and a mobile one if it touches the mobile layout)
